chapter: Barnet, 52nd Street and New York recording dates
title: His apartment at 555 Edgecombe
summary: He lived at 555 Edgecombe, with Don Redman next door and Joe Louis and Erskine Hawkins in the building, and later gave the apartment to Johnny Hodges.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yes, I had an apartment in New York. In fact, the same apartment I had, I finally let Johnny Hodges and Edie Q., his wife, have that apartment at 555 Edgecombe. That was my apartment, 9H. I never forget that. I let them have it later on, my apartment, when I was moving, right up over the Polo Grounds.
Well, that was my apartment first, you know, years back. Don REDMAN was next door to me. He had the

very next apartment to me, and down on the first floor Joe Louis had an apartment. Erskine Hawkins had an apartment in there. Yeah, that was a historical building back there then. Yeah, it was a nice building. I enjoyed it. I remember when Joe Louis fought Billy Conn, I was living in that building at the Polo Grounds back there then.
